CustomField.formula: IF ( AND ( DATE(YEAR(TODAY()),MONTH( Birthday_BDT__c ),DAY( Birthday_BDT__c )) <= (TODAY() + 7), DATE(YEAR(TODAY()),MONTH( Birthday_BDT__c ),DAY( Birthday_BDT__c )) >= (TODAY() - 7) ), IMAGE("/resource/BirthdayCupcake","Happy Birthday!", 32, 32) + " " + TEXT(DAY(Birthday_BDT__c)) + "-" + CASE( MONTH( Birthday_BDT__c), 1, "Jan", 2, "Feb", 3, "Mar", 4, "Apr", 5, "May", 6, "Jun", 7, "Jul", 8, "Aug", 9, "Sep", 10, "Oct", 11, "Nov", "Dec" ) + "-" + TEXT(YEAR(Birthday_BDT__c)), NULL )
CustomField.label: Birthday in ±7 Days (BDT)
